# dsh-lit-filecheck
A DSH plugin that brings the **lit + FileCheck** test loop into a session. Three tools:
| Tool | What it does |
| `lit_run` | Runs `llvm-lit` in a suite root and reports total/passed/failed/skipped, splitting eac
h failure block into per-CHECK diagnostics: which line holds the CHECK, which line of the actual IR

broke it |
| `lit_rerun_failed` | Re-runs only the tests that failed in this plugin instance's previ

ous `lit_run` (no full-suite rescan) |
| `filecheck` | Runs FileCheck once on an explicit pair of "t
est file with CHECK lines + actual IR file" and reports match/mismatch with the offending lines |
Plugin id `lit-filecheck`, npm package `dsh-lit-filecheck@0.1.0`, ESM, no background jobs and no per
sisted state (the rerun target lives in plugin-instance memory only).

`extraArgs` containing `--input-file` or `-` is rejected (`invalid-extra-args`) because it would ove

Returns `ok, mismatches[], stdout, stderr, truncated, logPath, durationMs, error, hint`; only exit c

## Shape of a failure diagnostic
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The plugin reads line `<line>` of the test file as `pattern` and the text after `CHECK:` as `expecte
d`; `actualLine` / `actualText` come from the first available note: `note: possible intended match l
ocated ...` first, then `note: scanning from here`. **When neither note exists they stay `null` — no
thing is invented.**
Crash dumps (`PLEASE submit a bug report` / `Stack dump`) never masquerade as diagnostics; they go t
o the log and `warnings` only.
## Error codes
`invalid-input`, `path-not-found`, `not-a-directory`, `tool-missing`, `spawn-failed`, `timeout`, `li
t-internal-error`, `no-previous-run`, `invalid-extra-args`, `no-check-lines`, `log-write-failed`, `p
ror`, `no-previous-run`, `invalid-extra-args`, `no-check-lines`, `log-write-failed`, `parse-failed`.
Failures are returned as `ok:false` + `error{code,message}` + an actionable Chinese `hint`; nothing
s are returned as `ok:false` + `error{code,message}` + an actionable Chinese `hint`; nothing throws.
## Logs
The full output is written to `<logDir>/lit-<yyyyMMdd-HHmmss>-<rand>.log` with argv, cwd, start/end
time, exit code, counts, failure details, and complete stdout/stderr. The stdout/stderr in the tool
result are clipped to `maxOutputBytes` (head and tail kept). If the log cannot be written, `logPath:
null` plus a `log-write-failed` warning — the result itself is still returned.

## Known limitations
- **`lit.cfg.py` must be pure ASCII**: on Windows lit reads config files with the platform locale (G

BK) and dies on non-ASCII comments with `UnicodeDecodeError`.
- A `.cmd` / `.bat` `llvm-lit` is reje

cted on purpose; use `llvm-lit.py` + `pythonPath`.
- Under the DSH restricted sandbox, piped Node sp
awns are denied (`spawn EPERM`) and lit's multiprocessing pool hits `PermissionError`; the tools the
n return `spawn-failed`. Host-side runs work normally.
